role: TileEntitySpecialRenderer for TileEntityBeacon: draws the rotating beacon beam (two textured prism passes, additive blend for the core and alpha blend for the sheath) whose height is the beacon's func_146002_i signal level.
scope_reason: world.conf beacon = off: the beacon is a plain block, TileEntityBeacon is never created, so this renderer is never reached in the oracle either.
notes: The beam math scrolls its V coordinate with the world total time, which a future port would take from the tick clock, not the wall clock.
